newsitem.title: USA: U.S Northwest spot prods notionally one cent lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S Northwest spot prods notionally one cent lower.

text.p: Spot gasoline prices in the U.S. Northwest edged up despite weakness in neighbouring California, traders said, on concerns of tighter supplies in November.
Talk of maintenance on Texaco's Anacortes refinery in Washington and pressure testing on the state's Olympic Pipe Line next month, put upward pressure on values.
"People are seeing short-term tightness," a trader said.
Seattle conventional regular gasoline rose a notional one cent to 61/62 cents a gallon on Thursday.
Seattle low sulphur diesel remained at 75/76 cents and jet fuel climbed a notional cent to 75/76 cents a gallon.
